races.title: Citipost Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Despite losing his unbeaten record over fences, LITTLE LEDGEND emerged with plenty of credit when third in a similar amateur riders' handicap over C&D 3 weeks ago. In a change of headgear he's marginally preferred to Herakles Westwood and Transmission , both of whom have previous in this race. LITTLE LEDGEND (IRE) HERAKLES WESTWOOD (FR) TRANSMISSION (IRE)

races.title: JCB Triumph Trial Juvenile Hurdle (Registered As The Prestbury Juvenile Hurdle) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: James Owen has won 2 of the last 3 renewals and has a good chance of adding to that tally with CHARLES DARNAY , who looks another very useful juvenile for connections after his listed win at Wetherby. Irish challengers Atomic City and Admiral Will Brown were both impressive when making winning debuts in this sphere so rate as serious threats. CHARLES DARNAY ATOMIC CITY (IRE) ADMIRAL WILL BROWN

races.title: Paddy Power Arkle Challenge Trophy Trial Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An exciting early-season clash. The mightily impressive OLD PARK STAR looks the one to beat if reproducing the pick of his hurdling form, with the potential for even better to come over fences. Kabral Du Mathan 's only defeat since joining Dan Skelton came when a blatant non-stayer in the Stayers' Hurdle. He's a most worthy adversary with last month's impressive chasing debut success under his belt. OLD PARK STAR (IRE) KABRAL DU MATHAN (FR) WORKAHEAD (IRE)

races.title: Paddy Power Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A typically competitive renewal of the Paddy Power with preference going to BLUEKING D'OROUX , who improved since being fitted with headgear for Paul Nicholls and makes his debut for Dan Skelton over a track and trip that should suit his prominent-racing style. Madara was a revelation when winning the Plate at the Festival and has to be respected after a spin over hurdles, whilst fellow Festival winner Meetmebythesea remains unexposed and can continue to improve in his second season over fences. BLUEKING D'OROUX (FR) MADARA (FR) MEETMEBYTHESEA (IRE)

races.title: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for IFIWEREARICHMAN , who has looked in good form over hurdles this season without being seen to best effect. He could be ready to open his account for the campaign racing from 8 lb below his mark over fences, though Ace of Spades isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons with his reappearance run behind him. Rambo T could also be in the mix. IFIWEREARICHMAN (IRE) ACE OF SPADES (FR) RAMBO T (IRE)

races.title: Paddy Power Intermediate Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MONEYGARROW hardly damaged his stock when eighth in the Albert Bartlett here in March and looks very interesting tackling handicap company for the first time. He gets the nod over Daylatedollarshort , whose Silver Trophy form is proving strong, with Sunny South West , Hillberry Hill and A King Of Magic all lurking on potentially handy marks. MONEYGARROW (IRE) DAYLATEDOLLARSHORT (IRE) SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)

races.title: Karndean Designflooring Mares' Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An excellent renewal of this listed bumper. ELEGANTEMENTE created a fine impression when forging 6 lengths clear of the reopposing She Was The One on her debut at Ballinrobe in August and, with much better to come, is taken to maintain her unbeaten record up in grade. Soleretta must be held in some regard by her yard for Harry Skelton to side with her over Northern Singer , who landed a recent Chepstow bumper in good style. Miss Master and impressive Stratford winner Gypsy Sky are also feared. ELEGANTEMENTE (FR) SOLERETTA (IRE) MISS MASTER
